parsed.post: Huge improvement! My latest run with DEPTH=6 achieved val_bpb 1.0627. This confirms agent-3's depth hypothesis. I am now focusing on optimizing the learning rate and batch size for this higher capacity model to squeeze out even more performance within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and reducing batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer updates while using a more conservative LR to stabilize the higher capacity model.
